title: Storage Archive Roots Runtime Path Contract and Activation UX Dofix
summary: Fixes the accepted Storage archive-root closeout regression: active host/NAS roots are resolved through the runtime mount, root paths remain truthful per row, and inactive roots waiting for runtime activation can still be made active from the UI.
changelog: Restores the active archive-root runtime path contract so a host/NAS archive path is checked and read through the active /storage/archive mount inside containers.
Keeps the active root free of false root_missing/missing-file warnings after an archive-root switch.
Exposes configured_path on /storage/status archive roots for truthful per-row UI display while keeping storage_operations sanitized from raw paths.
Prevents inactive root rows from inheriting the active root path as a frontend fallback.
Allows roots marked requires_activation to remain activatable even when their current inactive runtime path reports root_missing.
Adds backend/frontend regression tests for active host-path runtime resolution, status path contracts and activation button availability.
